To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of 5-FU in combination with Ologen is more effective in maintaining IOP than Ologen alone after Ex-PRESS shunts surgery.
the combination of Ologen with 1 % 5-FU was effective in maintaining IOP at 1 year after Ex-PRESS surgery.
5-FU is as effective as mitomycin in maintaining intraocular pressure following Ex-PRESS mini-shunt surgery at 12 month.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new method of treatment for patients with glaucoma.
the effectiveness of adjunctive therapy in Ex-PRESS mini-shunt surgery.
the comparison of the effectiveness and safety of MMC, Ologen, and 5-FU used in Ex-PRESS mini-shunt surgery for the treatment of glaucoma.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the adjunctive agents MMC and 5-FU are more effective in maintaining IOP than Ologen alone.
Ologen with 4-FU or MMC is a safe and effective adjunct to Ex-PRESS surgery for medically uncontrolled POAG.
the adjunctive therapy of Ologen with 0.1 ml 5-FU or MMC 0.2 mg/ml for 3 min is as effective as Ologen with 3 min MMC 0.4 mg/ml.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the combination of Ologen with 0.5% 5-fluoroacil is a good choice for Ex-PRESS mini-shunt surgery, especially for patients with a higher risk of hypotony or bleb leak.
the addition of MMC or 5-FU to Ex-PRESS surgery may be beneficial in reducing postoperative IOP, and the addition of 5-FU may be as effective as MMC with fewer complications.
the use of MMC or 5-FU combined with Ologen is a safe and effective adjunctive to Ex-PRESS mini-shunt surgery.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Ologen with 0.5 mg/ml 5-FU can be as effective as MMC with Ex-PRESS shunts.
5-FU is as effective as mitomycin C in reducing IOP following ExPRESS surgery, and it is a more cost-effective option.
5-FU is as effective as mitomycin C in maintaining IOP control following Ex-PRESS implantation.
